text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After an outing with Orfevre, having bought a huge stack of books.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I will read it immediately. Arrange a venue.
choice_data_list: Then let's stop by that café.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre was lounging comfortably, engrossed in a novel. Trying not to disturb her, I was also relaxing with a cup of tea, when—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm.
That was unexpectedly worth the read.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The rest—
Ah... well, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After thinking for a moment, she picked out a random training book from the ones she bought.
It looks like she intends to keep reading like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The novel she was reading earlier was just the first volume, bought as a trial.
She seemed a little disappointed that she hadn't bought the sequel."
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should just run out and buy it quickly.)
(Maybe I should just run out and buy it quickly.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving her behind as she got absorbed in her book again, I quietly slipped away from the table.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I jogged back to the bookstore and quickly bought all the
published volumes. Time to head right back to the cafe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Jewelry Store Staff
text_block_list.text:
For the Jewelry Collection talk event,
the end of the line for numbered entry tickets is right over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our way was blocked by a mysterious, massive line
that wasn't there on the way here. After desperately
pushing and squeezing through the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Passerby Holding Apples
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, eek--!
I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mountain of apples the woman was carrying
rolled mercilessly across the floor....
Unable to just ignore it, you helped her pick them upâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's gotten completely late. Orfevre has books so I doubt she's bored, but having slipped out without a word, I feel bad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What were you doing?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—Speak.
I assume there is quite a grand explanation for this?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You explain that you ran off to buy the next volume of the novel with good intentions, but ran into trouble on the way back, which delayed you.
choice_data_list: Anyway, the lines were just insane...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Ha, ridiculous. Go trample them underfoot.
choice_data_list: Isn't that a bit too rough...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ho— You dare refuse? An order from me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a grim expression,
Orfevre abruptly stormed out of the store.
For now, I'd better chase after her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The silence is heavy...
Still, I was the one who kept her waiting for so long.
choice_data_list: I should make it up to you somehow...
I should make it up to you somehow...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Then, provide some entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Sing me some cheerful tune or something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sing right here...!?
This is deeply embarrassing.
Embarrassing, yes... but desperate times call for desperate measures."

text_block_list.name: Street BGM
text_block_list.text: (Tadaaa~ tadala~ lilah~~♪)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...The sounds are overlapping. It's grating on my ears.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I did not say you could stop.
Sing or dance to the beat of this sound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, I did my best to entertain her by singing and dancing desperately.
Thanks to that, it seemed like her mood was gradually improving...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Enough. We are going back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if it's safe to assume
she's back in good spirits.
In any case, I've thoroughly reflected on today's events.
choice_data_list: I'll do it even more smoothly next time.
I wonder if we should have a book cafe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next time I run off on an errand like that,
I should master the art of smooth shopping so I won't keep anyone waiting."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Your efforts are, at times, somewhat off the mark.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre let out an exasperated sigh.
However, she seems to be in a much better mood now.
—At any rate, let's keep striving!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a book café, you can read while quickly grabbing whatever catches your eye.
Shall we look for a shop with a good selection and atmosphere?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Find it swiftly and guide me there.
I command you to be my escort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she's still letting me show her around, it seems
I haven't lost her trust. Next time, I'll do my best
to make sure she's truly satisfied!
